situation: Filing or releasing a PDF with blacked-out passages
problem: Boxes drawn over live text leave the words selectable and copyable; nobody notices until a reader does
current_workaround: Acrobat Pro Redact if available; manual select/Ctrl+F test; Free Law x-ray only for technical users

user_group: Anyone who edits a PDF and re-sends it (contracts, offers, CVs)
situation: Sending a PDF that was edited/saved in place
problem: Incremental saves keep earlier versions inside the file; removed text can be recovered
current_workaround: Print to PDF / flatten, if the user knows the risk

situation: Sending an Excel workbook to a client or applicant
problem: Hidden or very-hidden sheets, hidden rows/columns, pivot caches and external links carry data the sender believes is gone
current_workaround: Document Inspector in desktop Excel (if known); copy values to a new workbook
frequency: recurring (weekly for these roles is plausible but unmeasured)

situation: Sending a Word document after review
problem: Tracked changes and comments reappear for the recipient even if hidden in the sender's view; reviewer names exposed
current_workaround: Accept all / delete comments; Document Inspector; Word's warn-before-sending option

user_group: Online sellers, renters, people emailing photos
situation: Emailing or iMessaging a phone photo or sending it 'as file'
problem: Original GPS coordinates and device serials travel with the photo
current_workaround: Rely on messenger stripping (only some apps/modes); image-only EXIF tools

situation: A vendor's support asks for a HAR file or logs
problem: HAR contains live cookies, bearer tokens and JWTs; a stolen HAR enabled the 2023 Okta-related attacks
current_workaround: Cloudflare HAR Sanitizer (repo archived 2026-06-22); manual editing

user_group: Office workers and developers using AI chat
situation: Pasting a document or log into an AI assistant
problem: Confidential names, keys or client data leave the organisation and cannot be recalled

situation: Sharing a config or .env snippet in an issue/forum or committing it
problem: Plaintext API keys in claude_desktop_config.json / mcp.json leak

situation: Sharing a GPX/FIT file with a club or on a forum
problem: Track starts and ends at home; platform privacy zones do not change the exported file
current_workaround: GPSBabel radius filter; text-editor deletion; FIT-only scrubber

problem: Many tools upload the file, and none show proof that the cleaned copy is clean

user_group: Small organisations publishing PDFs on their website
problem: Author names, emails, file paths and OS details exposed at scale; checking one-by-one is impractical

situation: Checking an HEIC photo before sending
problem: HEIC cannot be read by the current tool
current_workaround: Export as JPEG first; iOS share-sheet location toggle
